# KAISTEEL

> KAISTEEL LIMITED (Hong Kong) designs and supplies modular outdoor mobile kitchens with retractable canopies, manufactured at its manufacturing partner facility in Foshan, Guangdong, China, for B2B dealers, contractors and hospitality buyers in North America, Europe and Australia.

## Products

- PRO: 2300mm outdoor kitchen format with a 90-degree electric flip cover system.
- MAX: 2900mm extended format with a wider flip-cover system, expanded work area and open-canopy presentation.
- Custom / Bespoke Studio: non-standard configurations engineered from buyer-supplied CAD drawings, subject to technical feasibility and engineering review.
- Material options: 304 for applicable stainless-steel components; 316 options subject to project review. The complete product is not entirely stainless steel.

## Three supply paths (System Shell / Appliance-Ready / Full Package)

- System Shell: structural enclosure, cabinetry and worktop only; cooking, refrigeration and other regulated equipment are sourced locally by the buyer. This path is designed to reduce certification complexity at import. KAISTEEL does not itself hold CE, UL, SAA or CSA marks for the complete system.
- Appliance-Ready: service interfaces and cut-outs are engineered against the buyer's exact appliance model, manufacturer installation instructions and local requirements — there is no universal fixed cut-out size.
- Full Package: appliances are supplied only once the exact model, certificate scope, voltage and gas type are confirmed for the destination market.
- Standard PRO/MAX one-unit samples are available for qualified new partners. CUSTOM quantities require engineering review; no universal fixed MOQ applies.

## Logistics and delivery

- September 2026 catalog assembled loading references: PRO 10, MAX 8 units per 40HQ for the illustrated configurations. Modular packing requires separate assessment. Final approved packing plan governs.
- Target factory lead time: 30 days, applying after configuration approval and Technical Freeze; final production and shipment timing is confirmed in the quotation and order documents.
- Countertop thickness options: 6mm, 8mm, 10mm.
- Warranty: 15-year structural, 5-year surface-finish and 1-year functional-component limited coverage (residential and commercial).

## Commercial terms

- KAISTEEL outdoor kitchen systems are supplied on a made-to-order B2B basis; configuration, price, lead time, Incoterms and payment terms are confirmed only in the applicable quotation and order documents.
- Standard payment basis (unless the approved quotation states otherwise): 50% deposit and 50% balance before shipment. Payment instructions and secure payment links are issued only in the name of KAISTEEL LIMITED — KAISTEEL does not request payment to an individual, an unrelated third party or an undisclosed manufacturing supplier. See /commercial-terms.html.
